UP CM Visits Gorakhpur Amidst JCB Accident Controversy

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath visited Gorakhpur to meet the family of Aryavardhan Singh, a child who died in an accident. The incident occurred as a JCB, reportedly returning from Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav's roadshow, was involved in the accident. Akhilesh Yadav has commented on the child's death and attacked the Chief Minister, sharing a video related to the JCB. Adityanath expressed anger over the incident during Yadav's roadshow. Satya Hindi also reported that Adityanath challenged Yadav to contest elections from Ayodhya, and that the bulldozer controversy has escalated.
